theorem: For task-world map r:W->C and adapter-visible native map g:W->Z, an exact deterministic adapter A with r=A composed with g exists if and only if r is constant on every fibre of g.

proof.necessity: If g(w1)=g(w2), determinism gives A(g(w1))=A(g(w2)); if r=A composed with g then r(w1)=r(w2).
proof.sufficiency: When r is constant on every fibre, define A(z) as the common r value on g inverse of z; the definition is well-defined and r=A composed with g.

mixed_fibre_corollary: One same-visible-symptom pair with different minimal revision classes makes every singleton mapping unsound; UNRESOLVED is the terminal-preserving output.

arm-specific custody and solver-identity conditions pass
